current_business_claims.text: Cash for Non-Running & Mechanical Failure Vehicles.
A vehicle that won't start is exactly the kind of car we specialize in.
While most buyers want cars that drive off the lot, we specifically seek out vehicles that don't start, don't move, or aren't safe to drive.
Call us, tell us what you know about the problem, and we'll make you a cash offer based on the vehicle itself — not on whether it runs.

We purchase vehicles with every type of mechanical failure, including blown or seized engines, failed or slipping transmissions, overheated engines with cracked heads or warped blocks, broken timing belts or chains, catastrophic electrical failures, failed fuel pumps or fuel systems, broken axles and differential failures, and vehicles that simply won't start for unknown reasons.
If your mechanic told you it would cost more to fix than the car is worth, that's all we need to know.
We don't need a diagnosis — a description like "it won't start" or "the engine overheated and now it makes a knocking sound" is enough for us to make an offer.
Towing is always free, no matter where the vehicle is located in the Las Vegas valley.
We pay you cash before the car leaves your property.
Beyond the metal, many individual components — alternators, starters, AC compressors, catalytic converters, wheels, and body panels — can be refurbished and resold.
The value of a non-running vehicle depends on its weight, the demand for its specific parts, and the current market price of scrap metal.

Just tell us what you know — it won't start, it overheated, it makes a noise — and we'll base our offer on the vehicle itself.
The longer a car sits, the less likely it is to start — but it still has value to us.
